scale.note: Grim Dawn BH = 1.8 m is INFERRED (Legolas §2); every BH figure in this file inherits that grade.

presentation.lick_coherence: low — turbulent flicker with a characteristic timescale, NOT a pulse train and NOT the 1 Hz damage tick

primitive_bindings.projectile: RGB flask (material, opaque dark glass, pale reflection) — NOT value-index. Source mesh is literally boozebottle_molotov01.msh held at R Hand.
primitive_bindings.impact: flask shatter: white-hot bloom + radiating light streaks + an expanding pale elliptical GROUND RING (shockwave) resolving into flame; fire_burst_e0p_v2 at 0.7 scale. 3 glass shards (RGB) RETAINED as HOUSE — footage could not resolve them.
primitive_bindings.field: low, dense, BOILING DISC of orange-yellow flame with a white-hot centre, ragged orange fringe and SHORT TURBULENT TONGUES (not tall discrete licks), red-orange outer glow; ground-bound decal + particles (terrainOnly), 0.58 squash. Tongue flicker runs at its own 3.3–3.6 Hz turbulent rate, decoupled from the damage ticks.
primitive_bindings.residue: scorch decal 12.0 s — an IRREGULAR DARK SMUDGE WITH SOFT EDGES, not a clean circle, with faint smoke wisps and a few residual flame licks; fade begins at 11.0 s, fade-in 0.1 s
